Bold Ideas Big Impact

As Asia's premier global city university, SMU turns knowledge into action, advances research into real-world impact and bridges academia with industry, government and communities.

Discover SMU »

SMU Advances Singapore-India Bilateral Innovation Pathway

Bringing together 120 students from 55 institutions, the Singapore-India Hackathon deepens cross-border collaboration, while opening new pathways for talent development, industry engagement, and innovation.

Read more

SMU China Launches in Shenzhen to Develop Asia-Ready Talent and Forge Greater Partnerships

SMU’s first overseas office beyond Southeast Asia marks a strategic step in deepening the University’s partnerships with China and the Greater Bay Area, shaping the next phase of global growth in Asia through research, talent, and enterprise.

Read More

SMU Executive MBA Breaks into Financial Times Global Top 50

Rising nine places to 46th worldwide, the programme also ranks 9th globally for International Course Experience, reflecting its emphasis on cross-market learning and leadership development.

Read More

Olympic Champion Eileen Gu Joins SMU at the KFF Inspiring Women Leadership Series

The world's most decorated freestyle skier shared her thoughts on personal growth, human potential, and the importance of supportive networks in helping women thrive.

Read More

Global and Industry Partnerships

Bridging Asia and The World - Collaborate with SMU

At SMU, we forge purposeful partnerships with leading industries, top universities, and forward-looking corporates to co-create knowledge, drive innovation, and solve real-world challenges. Anchored in Asia with a global outlook, our collaborations bridge diverse expertise and markets—amplifying impact across education, research, and enterprise.

Discover your Match »

About SMU

Empowering Leaders, Innovators & Changemakers

Be part of a university that prepares you for tomorrow’s challenges, today.

Events

Explore What’s Ahead

The Lee Kuan Yew Global Business Plan Competition

Meet the trailblazing winners of the 12th Lee Kuan Yew Global Business Plan Competition. Emerging from over 1,500 applications across 91 countries, these next-generation founders are advancing bold deep-tech solutions to address pressing urban and sustainability challenges. 

Sep/Oct

SMU International Virtual Career Fair

The SMU International Virtual Career Fair connects alumni employers with diverse global talent through live chats, interviews, and streamlined hiring.

SMU Masters Day

Discover SMU’s 18 postgraduate programmes, connect with faculty and industry experts, and find the programme that best fits your career goals.
